question: What’s the directional bearing to the nearest garden from Omni Scottsdale Resort & Spa at Montelucia, Paradise Valley, AZ?
sql:
SELECT *, degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-111.972351 33.529412)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) AS angle  FROM pois
WHERE leisure = 'garden'
ORDER BY geometry <-> ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-111.972351 33.529412)',4326)::geography ASC
LIMIT 1;

[2].display_name: Omni Scottsdale Resort & Spa at Montelucia, Paradise Valley, AZ
